_note: Source of truth for every page. Coordinates, heights and places are real; dates, group sizes, places left, costs and itineraries are illustrative until the board confirms them. Rebuild with: python3 site/tools/build_assets.py routes && python3 site/tools/build_pages.py

expeditions.name: Tyresta
expeditions.terrain: Old-growth pine, bare granite, the fire field of 1999, bog boardwalks
expeditions.climate: Early March: −4 to +3 °C, frozen lakes, 11 hours of daylight
expeditions.note: Old-growth pine, bare granite and a forest regrowing since the fire of 1999. One hour from the city by bus, and a good first trip.
log: Gullmarsplan. Twenty-four at the bus stop, three with new boots.
Tyresta village. Map, water, first layers off.
Lunch on the granite above Årsjön, still frozen at the edges.
Back at the village. 16 km, nobody lost.

expeditions.name: Kebnekaise
expeditions.terrain: Moraine, scree, the Vierranvárri shoulder, a snow ridge to the top
expeditions.transport: Night train to Kiruna, bus to Nikkaluokta, 19 km on foot to the mountain station
expeditions.climate: Late August: 0 to +12 °C at the station, below zero on the summit ridge, wind
expeditions.note: Sweden’s highest summit, by the western route. Up before four, back at the mountain station by evening.
log: Kebnekaise mountain station, 690 m. Headlamps, porridge, silence.
Vierranvárri, 1,711 m. The first view of the ridge.
The north top, 2,097 m. Cloud, then no cloud.
Back at the station. 18 km, 1,900 m of ascent.

gallery: The last ridge to the top.

expeditions.name: Stockholm Archipelago
expeditions.terrain: Ice-polished granite shore, heath, pine, the old pilot station
expeditions.transport: Commuter train to Nynäshamn, bus to Ankarudden, boat to Öja
expeditions.note: Öja, the southernmost island of the archipelago. Granite polished by the ice age, a night in the pilot station, Sweden’s oldest lighthouse.
log: Nynäshamn. Rain in the forecast, none on the water.
Öja. Round the island clockwise, on the rock.
The pilot station. The lighthouse turns every nine seconds.
The boat back. 11 km, one swim, very short.

expeditions.name: Abisko
expeditions.terrain: Birch forest, the Abisko canyon, open fell, the Njullá ridge
expeditions.transport: Night train from Stockholm C to Abisko Turiststation, 1,002 km north
expeditions.climate: Mid-October: −5 to +4 °C, first snow on the tops, about nine hours of daylight, aurora on clear nights
expeditions.cost: Train, huts and food at cost, listed when registration closes
expeditions.leaders: Two club trip leaders; a certified guide for the Njullá ridge
expeditions.note: The first expedition this far north. Birch forest in its last colour, the first snow above the treeline, and the dark coming early.

itinerary.title: Up the Abisko valley
itinerary.text: Off the night train at eleven. Through the canyon and up Kungsleden along the river to the hut at Abiskojaure.

itinerary.title: Across the open fell
itinerary.text: Leave the trail. North over open fell above the birches, camp or hut depending on the snow line.

itinerary.title: Njullá, then the train
itinerary.text: The ridge to the top at 1,169 m with the guide, down to the station for the evening train south.

packing: Hat, buff, two pairs of gloves
Map and compass, the club brings the rest

gallery: Lapporten from the frozen shore of Torneträsk, midwinter.

expeditions.name: Sarek
expeditions.terrain: No trails, no huts, no signal. Frozen valleys and passes on ski
expeditions.transport: Night train to Gällivare, bus to Kvikkjokk, then on ski
expeditions.climate: March: −20 to −2 °C, long light, storms that last days
expeditions.leaders: Two certified mountain leaders, ski-touring experience required
expeditions.note: A week on ski through Sarek in March, with tents and sledges. For members who have done a winter trip with the club before.

activities.name: Hiking
activities.text: Day trails on Sörmlandsleden and Roslagsleden, an hour from the city. Every other weekend, all year.

activities.name: Climbing
activities.equipment: Harness and shoes, lent by the club
activities.text: Indoor walls through the dark months, granite crags south of Stockholm from May. Belay courses for beginners.

activities.name: Alpine
activities.text: Glaciers, ropes and early starts. Always with certified mountain guides, never more than six to a rope team.

activities.name: Winter
activities.text: Snowshoes, ski touring and frozen lakes. Short days, long light, very cold coffee.

activities.name: Expeditions
activities.text: Several days, far north. Night trains, mountain huts, no signal. Two or three a year, numbered.
